subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new public per-agent-model generation timeout surface, or keep operators on existing provider/run timeout surfaces plus narrower thinking and repetition fixes?
rationale: The missing behavior is a new public config/default surface with fallback semantics, and repository policy sets a high bar for new config knobs and compatibility-sensitive provider routing behavior.

options.title: Define per-model generation timeout
options.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and tests.

options.title: Use existing timeout surfaces
options.body: Decline a new config key and improve documentation around provider timeout, run timeout, first-event timeout, and idle watchdog behavior.

options.title: Split by failure mode
options.body: Leave generation timeout out of scope and route thinking stalls and repeated-output loops to their narrower canonical issues and PRs.

recommendation.title: Define per-model generation timeout
recommendation.body: Add a typed agent-default and per-model budget with explicit precedence, fallback handling, schema/docs coverage, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue guidance and current timeout/config history make steipete the strongest available owner for the product-direction choice.
